word:jinn.title: Jinn
word:jinn.note: Unseen beings made from fire, who like people can believe or disbelieve; surah 72 is theirs. Talal Itani's translation calls them "sprites". "Possessed" is from the same root.

entries.text: jānn (جانّ): jinn (as a kind). 7 times in 7 verses.
jinna (جِنَّة): jinn; madness. 10 times in 9 verses.
majnūn (مَجْنُون): possessed, mad. 11 times in 11 verses.

word:justice.title: Justice
word:justice.note: "Stand firmly for justice, as witnesses to God, even if against yourselves" (4:135).

entries.text: ʿadala (عَدَلَ): to be just; to set up equals. 14 times in 13 verses.
qisṭ (قِسْط): equity, fairness. 15 times in 15 verses.
muqsiṭ (مُقْسِط): one who is fair. 3 times in 3 verses.

word:jihad.title: Striving (jihad)
word:jihad.note: To strive, to struggle: "strive with your possessions and your lives in the cause of God" (9:41). The word is wider than fighting: it is used of parents who strive to make a child associate others with God (29:8, 31:15).

entries.text: jāhada (جاهَدَ): to strive, to struggle. 27 times in 26 verses.
mujāhid (مُجاهِد): one who strives. 4 times in 2 verses.
